    Who is an MVP in business?
    The MVP meaning in business, or minimum viable product, is a version of a product that is developed with the least amount of effort possible to get customer feedback before investing more resources into it. Business owners may want to consider minimum viable products when evaluating product growth strategies.

    Star Rating. What is the star rating for MVP Health Care?
    About this result
    Feedback
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    MVP Health Care's Medicare Advantage plans receive varying star ratings from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) for 2026, with some plans earning 4 out of 5 stars and others, like their PPO, rated at 3.5 out of 5 stars, reflecting overall quality, member satisfaction, and healthcare performance, though specific plan ratings depend on the chosen plan and location. 
    Examples of 2026 CMS Star Ratings for Specific MVP Plans: 
    • MVP DualAccess Complete (HMO D-SNP): 4.0 stars.
    • MVP Medicare Preferred Gold (HMO-POS): 4.0 stars.
    • MVP Medicare Complete Wellness with Part D (PPO): 3.5 stars.
    Key Things to Know About Star Ratings:
    • Plan-Specific:
      The rating is for each individual Medicare Advantage plan, not the entire company. 
    • CMS Evaluates:
      The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) evaluates plans annually on a 1-to-5 star scale. 
    • What's Rated:
      Ratings cover aspects like care quality, member experience, and prescription drug services. 
    To find the exact rating for your specific MVP plan, you should check the CMS website or use a plan comparison tool like the one from U.S. News Health.

      Benefits. What are the benefits of choosing MVP Health Care?
      About this result
      Feedback
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Choosing MVP Health Care offers benefits like affordable plans (including $0 premium options), broad network access, preventive care, wellness programs (fitness, nutrition), and robust digital tools, with specific advantages depending on the plan, such as prescription discounts, $0 telehealth, OTC allowances, and $0 copays for certain kids' services. Members benefit from comprehensive options for individuals, families, employers, and seniors (Medicare), focusing on cost savings, accessibility, and holistic well-being.
       
      Key Benefits
      • Affordability: Access to low-cost or $0 premium plans (Essential Plan, Medicaid, some Medicare Advantage) and prescription drug discounts. 
      • Comprehensive Coverage: Options for medical, dental, and vision, plus coverage for mental health, substance abuse, and chronic conditions. 
      • Wellness & Prevention: Access to preventive care, wellness programs (fitness, nutrition), and resources for weight management and family health. 
      • Digital & Telehealth: $0 copay telehealth visits and digital tools for ID cards, claims, and finding providers. 
      • Provider Network: Access to a network of providers and specialists, with some plans offering nationwide access. 
      • Medicare Advantage Perks: Specific benefits like OTC allowances, dental coverage, and free virtual care through platforms like Gia®. 
      • Flexible Designs: Customizable group plans for businesses, including those for small companies. 
      Examples by Plan Type
      • For Individuals/Families: Affordable plans, including the $0-premium Essential Plan and Child Health Plus.
      • For Seniors: Medicare Advantage plans with $0 premiums, prescription drug coverage (Part D), and dental/vision allowances. 
      • For Employers: Flexible group plans that meet ACA requirements and help manage costs.

        Mission. What is the mission of MVP Health Care?
        About this result
        Feedback
        An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
        AI Overview
        MVP Health Care's mission is to be the difference for customers by leading with humility, making health care more convenient, supportive, and personal, and building healthier communities through high-quality, cost-effective, and preventive care. They focus on closing gaps in care, improving patient outcomes, and empowering members with resources to stay healthy, all while acting as a mission-driven, not-for-profit entity. 
        Key Aspects of Their Mission
        • Be the Difference:
          To stand out as a caring health plan that makes a positive impact. 
        • Lead with Humility:
          Fostering a curious and humble culture, asking what's missing and what more can be done. 
        • Community Focus:
          Committed to the health and wellness of the communities in New York, Vermont, and New Hampshire. 
        • Quality & Cost-Effectiveness:
          Helping members access high-quality care efficiently, aiming for better outcomes and lower costs. 
        • Preventive Care:
          Emphasizing early diagnosis, reducing complications, and supporting overall wellness through programs and data. 
        • Personalized Support:
          Offering tailored health plans and resources, treating members like individuals. 
        In essence, MVP Health Care strives to be a trusted partner in health, making health insurance work better for people and communities by focusing on quality, affordability, and compassionate service.

          Service Area. What is the service area of MVP Health Care?
          About this result
          Feedback
          An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
          AI Overview
          MVP Health Care primarily serves members in New York and Vermont, with specific coverage expanding to parts of New Hampshire, and offers nationwide access to providers through its partnership with the Cigna network, allowing for care outside its core regional footprint, especially for services like urgent/virtual care or when traveling. 
          Core Service Areas:
          • New York: A significant focus, offering various plans for individuals, families, and employers. 
          • Vermont: Another key region for MVP Health Care's operations. 
          • New Hampshire: Some coverage is available in New Hampshire as well. 
          Nationwide Access:
          • Cigna Network:
            Through a strategic alliance, MVP members can access a broad national network of healthcare providers via Cigna when outside of MVP's primary service regions. 
          • Virtual & Urgent Care:
            Services like 24/7 virtual care and mobile app access (Gia® by MVP) provide broad accessibility beyond traditional service areas. 
          How to Check Specific Coverage:
          • Service Area Maps:
            MVP provides detailed maps for different plan types (Group, Individual, Medicare, etc.) on their website for specific county-level coverage details. 
          • Provider Search:
            You can search their provider directory or use the Cigna network search to confirm if a specific doctor or facility is in-network.

            History. What is the history of MVP Health Care?
            About this result
            Feedback
            An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
            AI Overview
            MVP Health Care, a not-for-profit insurer founded in 1983, serves members in New York and Vermont, focusing on accessible, affordable, and customer-centric health plans, expanding through strategic partnerships, like its recent affiliation with Independent Health, and leveraging data for better patient care, with a mission to "lead with humility".
             
            Key Aspects of its History & Mission:
            • Origin: Established in 1983 as a non-profit health plan. 
            • Service Area: Primarily serves residents in New York and Vermont. 
            • Customer Focus: Emphasizes understanding unmet needs (the "job-to-be-done") of consumers to create better healthcare experiences, using de-identified data for insights, notes Strategyn.
            • Core Values: Driven by curiosity, humility, and a commitment to continuous improvement, guided by questions like "what's missing?". 
            • Growth & Partnerships: Expands by partnering with providers and systems, such as the Albany Medical Center, to improve care access, and recently announced an affiliation with Independent Health, notes Vermont Public.
            • Services: Offers various insurance plans, partners with large networks like Cigna Healthcare for broader access, and provides wellness programs. 
            In essence, MVP's history reflects a journey from a regional insurer to a growing entity focused on data-driven, patient-centered strategies to make healthcare more accessible and effective in its service regions.
